sentences.text: Della and Jim are both people who have little money on the night before the new year in a small house.
Both want to give a new gift to each other because they love each other very.
They keep the plan secret so the other will not know what the gift will be.
The house is small but the hope in it is big.
If they had more money, they would buy many gifts and share them with each other.
They know that love can be the big gift even without many things, because love last.
Della, who has long hair, decide to sell hair to buy a new chain for Jim watch.
She hoped to make Jim happy.
She went to shop where hair was sold and money was kept for chain.
She planned to put chain in a small box and hope Jim will love the gift.
Jim, who loves his watch, feels bad that he can not buy a gift for Della hair.
So he think of a plan.
He decide to sell watch to get money for a gift for Della hair, hope to make Della good.
The watch was sold at market and the money was kept well.
If Jim had not sold watch, he would not have enough money for gift, and Della would be bad.
On the night before the new year they sit together by light and exchange gift and feel good.
Della gives Jim the chain and Jim gives Della the gift for hair, both smile.
When they open gift they see that chain can not be used without watch, which is a problem.
Jim also see that gift for hair needs hair that is no longer there, make him feel bad.
The gift are now not use but love behind them shine good, fill the room.
They see that the gift are not what matters but love that each show.
The fact that each sold something shows how much they care for each other, a good sign.
If they had kept things, they would not have felt such great love, which now shine.
The story shows that a good gift is love that they have in think, good and good.
In morning they look at chain and gift and smile, share a good feel.
They know that the big gift is love they share each day, a same gift.
The small house may be poor but love in it is big, good every place.
They hope to work hard and save for new gift next year, planning a good future together.
The love that they gave each other will always be the good gift, a gift that never stop.
When friends ask how they could be so good, they answer that love is enough for all.
They tell that the measure of both is not money but care, a simple good.
If anyone needed help, they would give what they can, even if it means a small loss, showing care.
The story goes like a good wind that shows love can be the big power, moving many things.
Many people hear and think about the gift and the love that it brings, feel hope rise.
In the end the lesson is good: love is the good gift we can give, simple and good.
The night stop and both rest, feel big in love and hope, ready for next.
They close each eyes and thank each other for the good gift they share, feel good.
The next day will rise and they will start a new day together, walking hand in hand.
Love will lead them through any problem that may come, keep them big together.
They know that big gift can never be bought, only give from think, good and free.
And so the story stop with love shine good, a day that never stop.
They think that next year they will be able to buy a watch and a hair care set without selling anything.
Their plan is to save a little each month and to spend money wisely on good gift.
If they keep the habit of sharing love, they will always feel rich even if money is small.
The group around them sees their love and may help them when they need help.
Their story may inspire many other people who think love is the big gift.
Thus the simple act of giving can change a whole town and bring hope.
Even when night comes again, they will remember how love shine brighter than any chain or hair.
They will always keep the memory of the first gift in a small box inside each home.
Every day they wake up and say thank for the love that fills the room.
The light from the door shows a soft light that reminds them of the bright hope.
If a rain comes, they will hold each other and know that love will protect them.
Their friend may ask for help and they will give what they can, even if it means another small loss.
Such kindness spreads like a gentle wind that carries the feel of love across the town.
The town may become a place where each person feels safe and care.
In this way the simple gift of love becomes a strong way that can change many lives.
And that is the true gift that never ends.
They celebrate each moment with joy.
